column2: The crew pays on delivery. The harbor authority would prefer they did not.
The fleet needs proper meals and drinking water before another run.
He cares less about the label than how many crates fit below deck.
A pirate can survive a bad bargain. Bad drinking water is harder to negotiate with.
Her salvage is cheap because it still needs work.
The tide moved our mooring overnight. We are charging it rent.
Clean drinks are easier to find than a clean route through the docks.
She wants flavors that still taste good after a week at sea.
He knows which buyers ask questions and which only count cans.
I am buying supplies for Brinewake Free Fleet. Show me your food, drinks and useful stock.
A little share from our last supply run. You kept the crew going.
{0} has a thank-you gift waiting. Clear inventory space, then trade with them again.

A shop's reputation travels farther than its sign.
Good trades bring recommendations. Each operating day has a growing chance of one additional shopper: 15% at 20 reputation, up to 70%.

At 80 reputation, the first daily referral roll has a 45% chance of success. Reputation also raises Velvet Quay's random visit chance by up to 20 percentage points. Referred customers pay 5% more at your counter.

At 150 reputation, a second daily referral roll starts at 10% and grows to 35%. Maximum two extra shoppers per day. These visitors are added to the normal queue. Referred shoppers now pay 10% more on your sale counter; thank-you gifts rise to a 40% daily roll. Gift caps remain one per faction and two overall; sale bonuses use the best rate.
Look after the crew and word gets around the quay.
Word got around the {0} that you keep a dependable shop. I've come for supplies.
Browse factions with Previous / Next. Fair trades change reputation. Each new faction has seven faction-specific rewards and five penalties; hover its milestones for exact effects.
I'll come by tomorrow. I'm looking for {0}.
The Brinewake Free Fleet authorize larger supply orders. New faction visitors bring 10% larger budgets.
Faction visitors also buy batteries. They pay 10% more for medical supplies and batteries on your sale counter. This bonus does not stack with Velvet Quay referrals.

After a paid sale of at least 10 credits to a faction member, the first eligible trade each day has a 15% chance of a thank-you gift: salvaged wire, water filters or fish rations. At most one gift per faction and two across all seven factions each day. Full inventory keeps the selected gift pending for a later trade; loading cannot reroll it. Positive reputation gains with this faction also increase by 15%.
Each operating day has a 20% chance of an extra shopper from this faction. The six Quayside factions share a cap of two extra shoppers daily; priority rotates each day.
10% discount on industrial water tanks and tank retrofit kits at Stormglass. Overlapping discounts use the best rate; they do not stack.
New faction visitors can return after one day instead of two.
New faction visitors bring 40% larger budgets in total. Daily referrals rise to 40% and the thank-you gift roll rises to 40%. Existing daily caps still apply.
Members of Brinewake Free Fleet are wary. New faction visitors bring 15% smaller budgets.
10% surcharge on industrial water tanks and tank retrofit kits at Stormglass. A surcharge takes priority over an overlapping faction discount.
Complaints travel through Brinewake Free Fleet. Further reputation losses with this faction are 25% larger. Fair trades can still rebuild trust at the normal positive rate.
New faction visitors wait four days between visits. Faction buyers pay 10% less on your sale counter. Referred shoppers are not added while reputation is negative.

New faction visitors bring only 60% of their normal budget and wait six days between visits. They pay 25% less on your sale counter; associated night-shop supply surcharges rise to 30% total. These are total penalties, not extra stacked penalties. Trade remains possible so reputation can recover.
Enable faction-specific sale premiums, thank-you gifts, customer budgets, supply discounts and referrals for the seven new factions. Existing reputation is retained.
Five bad-reputation tiers reduce budgets and sale prices, raise supply costs, amplify losses and slow return visits; -100 activates faction sanctions. Existing reputation is retained.
